outline.title: Eight-month home-life horizon for Nicoletta Palmi
outline.note: Home-centred outline for a healthy 42-year-old high-school professor living in a large villa near Rimini.

attributes.description: Large villa balcony used for laundry and fresh air.
Spacious kitchen used frequently for cooking.
Garden, streets around Rimini and other outdoor areas.

recurringActivities.label: Morning toilet and shower
recurringActivities.note: Stable workday and weekend morning anchor.

recurringActivities.label: Morning contraceptive pill
recurringActivities.note: Represents regular use only when part of her chosen cycle; no health condition is inferred.

recurringActivities.label: Dinner at home
recurringActivities.note: Later on school days and more flexible on weekends.

recurringActivities.label: Evening hygiene
recurringActivities.note: Final stable home routine before the rhythm-owned night.

recurringActivities.label: Prepare a simple lunch
recurringActivities.note: Mainly on weekends when she is at home.

recurringActivities.label: Weekly meal preparation
recurringActivities.note: Reflects her enjoyment of cooking and preparation for the school week.

recurringActivities.label: Clean the kitchen
recurringActivities.note: Often follows cooking, but may shift within the evening.

recurringActivities.label: Start laundry
recurringActivities.note: Usually performed on a flexible weekend window.

recurringActivities.label: Indoor light exercise
recurringActivities.note: Home-observable abstraction of her regular gym habit.

recurringActivities.label: Buy groceries
recurringActivities.note: Flexible errand shaped by food inventory and school workload.

authoringAssumptions: The horizon starts on 2026-08-03 and spans eight calendar months.
Nicoletta lives alone because no other household members were specified.
Her school commitments are represented as fixed weekday commitments during the teaching periods, with a winter holiday gap.
Her regular contraceptive pill is represented as a daily morning medication activity, without inferring any medical condition.
Gym attendance is represented by indoor light exercise at home-level observability; travel and activity inside the gym are not detailed.
Boat use is represented as bounded warm-weekend outdoor leisure events at the closest catalog abstraction.
Meal, cleaning, laundry and leisure cadences were conservatively inferred from the stated preferences and occupation.
Nicoletta starts the horizon at home in the bedroom.

phases.note: Colder evenings reduce outdoor walking and shift activity indoors.
